preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Input consists of non-empty lines only (no empty lines).

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 5
preconditions.description: First line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N and N >= 1 and K >= 1 and K <= N for i in range(T) for S, K in [(stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1].strip(), int(stdin.splitlines()[2*i+2].strip()))])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is string S of length N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5), and the second line is integer K (1 ≤ K ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for S in [stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1].strip() for i in range(T)])
preconditions.description: All characters in S are lowercase English letters ('a' to 'z').

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == K for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line has exactly length K, matching the corresponding K in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == ''.join(sorted([subseq for subseq in combinations(S, K) if len(subseq) == K], key=lambda x: x)[0]) for i, (S, K) in enumerate(zip([stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1].strip() for i in range(T)], [int(stdin.splitlines()[2*i+2].strip()) for i in range(T)])) for output_line in [stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the lexicographically smallest subsequence of S of length K. This is the smallest string when all possible subsequences of length K are sorted lexicographically.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in [''.join(subseq) for subseq in combinations(S, K) if len(subseq) == K] for i, (S, K) in enumerate(zip([stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1].strip() for i in range(T)], [int(stdin.splitlines()[2*i+2].strip()) for i in range(T)])) for output_line in [stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid subsequence of the corresponding input string S.
